children: A cotton square scoured white, printed with lime outlines and clay dots, dyed in indigo, washed in running water and then in the cool of the morning, so the outlines and dots come up white on blue; beside it, white where lime held and the pinkish tinge madder leaves on open cloth.
clay dots, then the indigo vat
washed: the lines come up white
castor oil, soda ash, camel dung
soak, beat, dry, again and again
the alum stays, the resists wash out
